visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men, one in a pink tank top and a pink cap, and another in a brown sweatshirt and a black cap, stand in a brightly lit gym environment with weight racks and machines. A woman with dark hair in a tan tank top walks past in the background. (2) The man in the pink tank top lies on a bench press station, gripping a metal barbell. The woman in the tan tank top stands behind the bench, positioning her hands near the bar as a spotter. The man in the brown sweatshirt stands to the side, observing. (3) The man on the bench struggles to lift the weight, his facial muscles tensing and eyes squinting. The woman smiles while hovering her hands under the bar. (4) The man on the bench sits up quickly, laughing and gesturing with his hands. The man in the brown sweatshirt stands near a rack of black weight plates, talking while adjusting his cap. The woman walks away toward the background holding a clear water bottle with a yellow cap.
